desc:
GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Enjoy delicious Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks in Strawberry and Tropical flavors; These snacks are bursting with yummy liquid

FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

ON THE GO: Portable pouches are ideal for the pantry, school lunch box, team snacks, kids parties, and more

CONTAINS: One Family Pack of Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks Variety Pack; 20 Ct, 16 oz
features:
Features

Juicy Liquid Center

Soft chewy texture with a burst of juicy strawberry-flavored liquid inside.

Strawberry Splash Flavor

Bold, fruity taste that kids and adults love.

Single-Serve Pouches

Convenient 0.8 oz pouches ideal for lunchboxes, on-the-go snacks, or portion-controlled treats.

Good Source of Vitamin C

Each pouch provides approximately 10% of the daily recommended value of Vitamin C.

Gluten-Free, Gelatin-Free, and Dairy-Free

Suitable for various dietary needs, including gluten sensitivity and vegan preferences.

Low-Calorie Option

About 90 calories per pouch, making it a light, sweet snack.

Benefits

Fun & Interactive Snack

The liquid-filled center provides a playful and exciting eating experience.

Portable & Mess-Free

Individually wrapped for easy transport, no refrigeration needed, and no mess.

Flavor-Packed Treat

Delivers strong strawberry flavor without artificial flavors.

Great for Dietary Restrictions

Free from gluten, gelatin, and dairy, making it inclusive for many diets.

Contains Added Nutrients

Fortified with Vitamin C to support immunity and daily nutrient intake.
